description: How many parcels shinnslist tracks in a county, town or ZIP, with the count behind each buyer's trade (wholesaler, flipper, STR investor, developer, cash investor, land, family compound, realtor) and the as-of date. Counts come from county records, never estimates.

county.description: County name as the county files it.

state.description: CO or VA. Optional when county or zip is given.

town.description: A town or city name (parcels within about five miles).

name: town_stats
title: Area parcel counts
